answer_1.quote: In this section, we conduct experiments for our method based on two parts: DP text re-write for fine-tuning (private embedding) and downstream tasks (sentiment analysis).
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are perturbed sentences where sensitive words are replaced through private embedding mechanisms, such as in: 'Oh and we came on a Saturday night around 9:30pm for <unk>'

answer_2.quote: We use the loss of cross-entropy to measure the performance of language models. ... Additionally, we will use Rouge1 and BLEU scores. ... Moreover, we use BERTScore to measure the semantic similarity of the perturbed sentence with the original one.
